description: Test whether the ACRV1 LU domain is more conserved across mammalian orthologs than the disordered stalk
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})

# --- ACRV1 orthologs from UniProt (reviewed + unreviewed, gene ACRV1) ---
q='(gene:ACRV1) AND (taxonomy_id:40674)'   # Mammalia
r=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
        params={'query':q,'format':'fasta','size':500},timeout=120)
fa=r.text
seqs={}
for blk in fa.split('>')[1:]:
    h,s=blk.split('\n',1); s=s.replace('\n','')
    org=re.search(r'OS=(.+?) OX=',h); acc=h.split('|')[1]
    if 150<len(s)<500: seqs[acc]=(org.group(1) if org else '?', s)
print("ACRV1 mammalian entries retrieved:", len(seqs))
for a,(o,s) in list(seqs.items())[:20]: print(f"  {a:10s} {len(s):4d} aa  {o}")

human=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P26436.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n',1)[1].replace('\n','')

# --- pairwise identity of LU domain vs stalk, via simple global alignment on each segment ---
from itertools import product
def nw(a,b,gap=-8):
    # BLOSUM62-lite: identity scoring, sufficient for a % identity estimate
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); 
    M[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; M[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sc=np.where(np.array(list(b))==a[i-1],4,-2)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=M[i-1,j-1]+sc[j-1]; u=M[i-1,j]+gap; l=M[i,j-1]+gap
            k=int(np.argmax([d,u,l])); M[i,j]=[d,u,l][k]; P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; ai=[];bi=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: ai.append(a[i-1]); bi.append(b[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: ai.append(a[i-1]); bi.append('-'); i-=1
        else: ai.append('-'); bi.append(b[j-1]); j-=1
    A=''.join(ai[::-1]); B=''.join(bi[::-1])
    m_=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A,B) if x==y and x!='-'); al=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A,B) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    return 100*m_/max(al,1), al

hs_stalk=human[21:185]; hs_lu=human[185:265]
rows=[]
for acc,(org,s) in seqs.items():
    if acc=='P26436': continue
    # LU domain of ortholog = C-terminal 80 aa after last cysteine-rich block
    o_lu=s[-85:]; o_stalk=s[21:max(22,len(s)-85)]
    if len(o_stalk)<40: continue
    id_lu,_=nw(hs_lu,o_lu); id_st,_=nw(hs_stalk,o_stalk)
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,org=org,len=len(s),id_LU=id_lu,id_stalk=id_st))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('id_LU',ascending=False)
print("\n=== percent identity to human ACRV1: LU domain (C-term 80-85 aa) vs disordered stalk ===")
print(df.head(25).to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:5.1f}"))
from scipy import stats
d=df.id_LU-df.id_stalk
w=stats.wilcoxon(df.id_LU,df.id_stalk)
print(f"\nn = {len(df)} orthologs | mean LU identity {df.id_LU.mean():.1f}% | mean stalk identity {df.id_stalk.mean():.1f}%")
print(f"mean difference {d.mean():+.1f} pp (95% CI {d.mean()-1.96*d.sem():+.1f} to {d.mean()+1.96*d.sem():+.1f}) | Wilcoxon signed-rank p = {w.pvalue:.2e}")
print(f"Cohen's d (paired) = {d.mean()/d.std():.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,5.5))
for _,x in df.iterrows():
    ax.plot([0,1],[x.id_stalk,x.id_LU],color='#9aa5ad',lw=.8,alpha=.7)
ax.scatter([0]*len(df),df.id_stalk,color='#f4a261',zorder=3,s=38,label='disordered stalk (22-185)')
ax.scatter([1]*len(df),df.id_LU,color='#2a6f97',zorder=3,s=38,label='LU domain (186-265)')
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(['disordered stalk','LU domain'])
ax.set_ylabel('percent identity to human ACRV1'); ax.set_xlim(-.35,1.35)
ax.set_title(f'The LU domain is the conserved part of ACRV1\n{len(df)} mammalian orthologs, paired Wilcoxon p = {w.pvalue:.1e}',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9,loc='lower center')
for s_ in ['top','right']: ax.spines[s_].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
